description: Master clock and seed manager for Seeds of Change: it counts clocks and sends reseed and new seed triggers at the divisions set here.

params.text: Sets how many clocks pass between reseed triggers, from 1 to 999.
Scales the CV for the division it belongs to, from -100% to +100%; a volt moves that division by 100 steps at full.
Sets how many clocks pass between new seed triggers, from 1 to 999.
Delays the clock output and the reseed trigger by up to 10 samples, so a seed fetched by the new seed trigger reaches the seed output in time.
Steps between the two division reset modes: in one the reseed count runs on its own, in the other a new seed trigger restarts the reseed count as well.

inputs.text: The clock that both divisions count.
A trigger here zeroes both counts, and the next clock fires a reseed and a new seed.
The seed value that gets held and passed on, sampled when a new seed falls due; polyphonic cables are carried through.
Moves the division it belongs to, scaled by the attenuverter for that division.

outputs.text: The clock input passed on, delayed by the number of samples set by DELAY COMP.
The seed value held at the last new seed trigger, on as many channels as the seed input carries.
A 1ms 10V pulse each time the reseed division is reached.
A 1ms 10V pulse each time the new seed division is reached; patch it at whatever supplies seed values.

notes: nothing counts until a clock is patched into the clock input.
for a repeating Seeds of Change, patch the clock output to its clock input, the reseed output to its reseed input, and the seed output to its seed input.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
